ai_summary: 3B BlackBio Dx Limited has formally announced its 54th Annual General Meeting (AGM) for September 29, 2026, to be held virtually, along with details for the FY2025-26 dividend and e-voting. The primary material impact for shareholders is the **Record Date of September 22, 2026**, which determines eligibility for both the declared dividend (payable on or after October 5, 2026) and participation in remote e-voting. This appears to be a standard regulatory disclosure of corporate actions, with no immediate red flags identified.
